name: Stone Rune — Enthrall
desc: When a creature you can see ends its turn within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to invoke the rune: it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Constitution modifier) or have the Charmed condition for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it has a Speed of 0 and the Incapacitated condition. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once per Short or Long Rest (twice from level 15, Master of Runes).
